name: p19-narrator-01-far-beyond-neptune-icy-pluto-and
text: Far beyond Neptune, icy Pluto and its giant moon Charon travel around a shared meeting point. New Horizons flew past in twenty fifteen and saw a bright heart of nitrogen ice. Pluto is still a real world — one of five official dwarf planets.

name: p19-narrator-02-pluto-and-charon-travel-around-a
text: Pluto and Charon travel around a meeting point in the space between them. That shared dance is something we can see.

name: p19-narrator-07-charon-pluto-s-giant-companion-about
text: Charon. Pluto's giant companion, about half as wide.

name: p19-narrator-13-charon-is-about-half-as-wide
text: Charon is about half as wide as Pluto — the largest moon compared with its world.

name: p19-narrator-16-pluto-has-five-known-moons-charon
text: Pluto has five known moons: Charon, and four much smaller ones named Styx, Nix, Kerberos, and Hydra.
